_comment: v0.1.0 'cart' pump (op_cart.py, cart_gen.py, cart_check.py, V010-CART.md): Accu-Chek Insight-type 1.6 ml cartridge + original Insight Adapter & Tubing, NFP-608-26.45 + spur pair + translating M2 piston rod, cup-pod main board unchanged. TEST ONLY, WATER ONLY. Every cartridge / adapter number is an ESTIMATE until measured on a sample (docs/insight-research.md: no drawings are public).
_fdm: FDM-first (owner 2026-11-24): wall 1.2 (3 perimeters at 0.4), fits +0.2..0.3 on every printed-to-bought interface (cradle, receiver bore, lug groove, slider channel, motor saddles, button), see V010-CART.md print guide

cartridge.part: Accu-Chek Insight-class 1.6 ml glass cartridge: NovoRapid PumpCart format (type 1 glass, bromobutyl stopper, bromobutyl/polyisoprene septum, SmPC 6.5 VERIFIED); bench sample = EMPTY mylife YpsoPump Reservoir 1.6 ml (PZN 11160770, same cartridge class, fit with the Insight adapter UNVERIFIED). WATER ONLY.
cartridge.status: ISO 13926-1 cartridge family (SCHOTT TopLine/StandardLine table, VERIFIED for the ISO rows): 1.6 ml ISO row OD 10.95 / ID 9.25; crimp neck collar d4 7.15 +-0.2, neck d5 5.5 +-0.25, bore d6 3.15, neck+collar h1 5.0, collar h2 2.9 (shared by all ISO rows 8.65-11.6 OD). That the PumpCart / YpsoPump Reservoir IS the 1.6 ml ISO row, the cap OD 7.8, the barrel length and the stopper are ESTIMATE: MEASURE (docs/insight-research.md section 7); the fit coupons print a bore ladder 11.0-11.8

adapter.part: original Accu-Chek Insight Adapter & Tubing 40 cm (REF 06485472001, PZN 08460327, 10 per box): adapter with central needle, bayonet nose, vent (>= 0.65 bar), tubing integrated. Unmodified apart from the clip-on lock flag.
adapter.status: ALL geometry ESTIMATE (manual: nose enters the housing notches, turns clockwise to a stop, flush with the housing); MEASURE

cup._lugs: owner 2026-11-25 + photo crops: 2 OUTWARD hook lugs at the cup tip ON the adapter long axis, unequal (far-half side ~5.1, near-end side ~3.1 chord), ~0.5 radial, ~1.4 axial (ramped top, flat underside); lug_w[0] = the lug at lock_deg (far half, +Y when flush)
cup._pump_photos: owner photos of an ORIGINAL Insight pump end face (2026-11-25, 3 views, scale = end face 19 wide): the cartridge passes the bore, so the retaining wall between the 2 windows is > 10.95 and the cup lip must be larger than read from the adapter photo (~11.9, VERIFY); the adapter's raised far half starts ~13.5 from the cup (side photo ramp), matching the pump's curved rim ~12 around the bore; the 2 underside holes ~11 from the cup at +-5 take the pump's detent ball.
cup._comment: PHOTO-ESTIMATE from the owner's adapter (2026-11-25, 3 photos, scale = adapter width 19.0 -> ~21 px/mm, +-0.5-1): the underside is flat; a dark CUP (female, OD ~10.3, ID ~8.4 with 4 internal ribs and the needle hole) stands ~4.7 proud near one end (centre ~10.3 from that end); an outward LIP on the cup rim (~11.1 OD, ~0.6 high) = the bayonet lugs, interrupted by flats on the long axis (-> lips centred across the width, lip_rel_deg 90, ~80 deg each: VERIFY); a white seal ring OD ~13.5 (~0.8 thick, ~0.5 compressed) around the cup base; the far half of the underside stands ~2.5 proud with an ARC edge ~24 from the cup axis; a hook / spring tongue at that arc ~7 off the long axis snaps at the flush position; tubing leaves the far end in an underside channel. Adapter length ~49-50 (conn_from_end 11.5 centres a ~50 adapter on the 52 face). Mounting (owner): on at 90 deg (sticking out), turned 90 deg down to flush, hook latches.

adapter._patents: US D720,449 S 'Pump adapter' (8 views) and US D689,523 S 'Infusion pump device' (Fig. 6: end face with the adapter removed), Roche, filed 2012-02-03: adapter 48-52 x 18-19 x 9-10, nose OD ~13 at ~12.5 from the nose end, 2 lugs on the long axis (one ~5 wide, one ~1.5), underside step 2.5-3.3 on the tubing half, tubing out of the far end ~2 above the underside; pump bore ~11.7-12.4 with 2 notches 180 deg apart (60-80 deg arc), counterbore ~15-17. Unscaled drawings -> ESTIMATE
adapter._geometry: Roche manual p.2 / 27 / 28 / 29 / 36 + adapter IFU figures + owner photo (2026-11-24): the adapter caps and FORMS the pump's 52 x 19 end face (cartridge along the 84 length). Underside view p.29: L/W 2.8, round nose (needle in its centre) about 29 % of L from the nose end (-> 15 mm), raised key step on the tubing half (side view, about 1.5), tubing leaves the far narrow end along the long axis. Body 52 x 19 x 9.5 (84 - ~74.5 body). Mounting: nose on the septum with the needle perpendicular, long axis at 90 deg, clockwise to the stop (90 / 120 deg marks) until aligned. ALL ESTIMATE from renders: measure the bought adapter

receiver._comment: A (round 3, owner 2026-11-25): bayonet for the adapter cup's 2 outward hook lugs. Rim (ID tab_id) from the face down to just above the lugs, with 2 keyed WINDOWS (lug width + 2 x lip_clr) at entry_deg (wide lug, +Z: the adapter goes on standing at 90 deg, far half up) and entry_deg + 180 (narrow lug). Under the rim 2 UNDERCUT pockets (diameter bore_d, from the rim underside to cup proud + clearance) that run travel_deg CLOCKWISE seen from the face (+Z -> +Y) from each window and end in a radial STOP face at the flush position (wide lug at +Y = lock_deg); optional snap bump (snap_bump radial) just before the stop. Seal seat cbore_d x cbore_depth, recess outside recess_r, ball detent pockets, hook pockets as before. PHOTO-ESTIMATE.

gears.part: brass spur gears module 0.3: pinion z12 bore 2.0 (on the NFP D-shaft, Loctite 648; root d 2.85, rim 0.42), gear z40 (tip d 12.6) with a hex pocket for the M2 nut (drill + file or print-and-bond), CANDIDATE listings in BUY-LIST section 7

rod.part: DIN 975 threaded rod M2 x 0.4, brass or zinc-plated steel (GHW), cut to rod_len; never wet (behind the stopper)

nut.part: DIN 934 M2 brass, AF 4.0, h 1.6, bonded in the gear hex pocket

slider.part: printed anti-rotation slider bonded on the rod rear end, runs in the U channel of the tub

pusher.part: printed / turned pusher disc on the rod front end, flat face on the stopper

magnet.note: diametric d2 x 1 (BUY-LIST A4) bonded on the pinion front face / shaft end

board.part: NEW cart board outline (owner 2026-11-24): same chip set as the cup board (HJ-840, STM32C011, TPL5010, TPS2553, TPS61023, DRV8838, MCP73832, USB-C, RGB LED, sounder, side button, TMAG strip), no dock hall (adapter-lock hall on a pigtail instead), 4 layers 0.8 mm if it routes (long narrow outline over the whole lane 2); length follows the housing (x0 .. collar), width w; parts <= 1.45 top / 1.2 bottom. Fit print: dummy only

button._comment: sealed button in the +Y wall in front of the board's side switch SW1 (SKSCLAE010, actuator toward +Y). Cap = flush mushroom: head d5.0 in a 0.8 deep outside recess (+0.3 clr), stem d2.4 through the d2.5 hole, barb ring d3.2 x 0.5 snaps behind the wall; the head flange seals on the recess floor. Print in TPU 95A (FDM) or cast in silicone A40 in the printed 2-part mould (mould STL follow-up). z_c = board top + 0.6 (actuator centre, VERIFY on the board).

screws._comment: lid held by 3 x M2 x 8 cheese/pan head screws from the UNDERSIDE (no screws on top): head in a flush counterbore of the floor, thread-forming into d1.6 pilots of lid bosses that reach down to 0.2 above the floor

lock._comment: adapter-locked sensing: the board's dock hall input (DRV5032) on a short flex at the front wall reads a d1 x 0.5 magnet on a clip-on flag of the adapter; it drives the existing DOCKED gate (forward only when locked, reverse only when unlocked)

taper._comment: owner 2026-11-24: full 52 x 19 only where the adapter / board / cell sit; the +Y side eases (two tangent R17.5 arcs) to 38 behind the motor; R8 rear corners; one parting line at z 15 (cap lid 3.5), R2 top / bottom edges

coupons._comment: print these first (cart_gen.py -> out/v010-cart/coupons): the cartridge must slide through its hole with a light touch -> cradle_clr; the adapter nose must enter the receiver and turn to the stop -> receiver.bore_d / lug geometry

yoke._comment: yoke drive (variant A since 2026-11-24): M2 screw beside the barrel (rotating, axially fixed: rear end in a rear-wall boss, z40 gear on its front end between two ribs beside the barrel), printed yoke with the brass M2 nut rides on it, arm across to the cartridge axis, d3 stem + pusher disc into the cartridge; the yoke foot runs in a floor channel (anti-rotation). Nothing behind the cartridge but yoke + stem.
yoke.stem_part: brass or steel rod d3.0 (any 3 mm brass round rod), cut to length, bonded (CA) into yoke and pusher

A._comment: Variant A: original Accu-Chek Insight Adapter & Tubing (needle + vent + tubing, bayonet into our receiver), Insight Flex head set at the far end (bench container)

B._comment: Variant B: printed bayonet cap (same receiver as A) that centres a standard Luer-lock hypodermic needle (B. Braun Sterican 27G 0.40 x 12 mm, female Luer hub) on the septum axis and presses the crimp cap axially (like the Insight adapter's O-ring); the hub takes a Luer tubing set (Accu-Chek FlexLink transfer set, Luer-lock pump end: gender VERIFY, else add a male-male Luer-lock coupler). No commercial cartridge-to-Luer adapter exists (research 2026-11-24). Needle and hub numbers ESTIMATE.

needle_cap._hub: Sterican-type female Luer-lock hub: nose cone d~4.4 at the needle end, body + lug flange d~7.6, length ~11 (ESTIMATE, measure); the mating male Luer-lock collar needs d~10 clear around the hub top
